MATCH (s:State {name: 'Colorado'})<-[:LOCATED_IN]-(p:IP)<-[:FROM_IP]-(sh:Shop) RETURN sh.name, count(DISTINCT p)
MATCH (o:AccountHolder)-[:HAS_BANKACCOUNT]->(b:BankAccount) WHERE b.balance > 1000 MATCH (o)-[:HAS_CREDITCARD]->(c:CreditCard) WHERE c.limit > 50000 RETURN o.fullName, b.accountNumber, c.limit
MATCH (p:AccountHolder)-[:HAS_BANKACCOUNT]->(b:BankAccount {addressNumber: 'Schuppe, Schuppe'}), (p)-[:HAS_CREDITCARD]->(c:CreditCard) WHERE c.balance > 300 RETURN p.firstName, p.lastName
MATCH (p:AccountHolder)-[:HAS_UNSECUREDLOAN]->(u:UnsecuredLoan), (p)-[:HAS_CREDITCARD]->(c:CreditCard) WHERE u.loanAmount > 10000 AND c.latePayments > 0 RETURN p.name, u.loanAmount, c.latePayments
MATCH (c:AccountHolder)-[:HAS_UNSECUREDLOAN]->(u:UnsecuredLoan), (c)-[:HAS_BANKACCOUNT]->(b:BankAccount) WHERE u.APR > '0.5' AND b.name = 'Hyatt Group' RETURN c.name, u.APR, b.name
